label: Wix Stores
terms_note: Wix site with Wix Stores (Business / eCommerce premium plan); API keys are created by the account owner / co-owner with scopes + site access and are not available to third-party apps — a distributed app must be an OAuth app from the Wix Developers Center (App Market review for public listing); OAuth app tokens 4 h; 429 on throttling (numbers not published); 409 revision checks on updates.

discovery.auth: api_key (account-owner API key from the Wix API Key Manager with Stores scopes + `wix-site-id` header) or OAuth app (client_credentials, 4-hour tokens) for a Wix Developers Center app
sdks: .md mirrors of every doc page + https://dev.wix.com/docs/llms.txt

official_mcp: Wix MCP (dev.wix.com documents API keys for 'AI agents and MCP server connections')
rate_limits: 200 requests/min per instance + read/write quotas (search); 429 on throttle (vendor troubleshooting page)

auth: 1. Tenant (account owner) creates an API key in the Wix API Key Manager with Wix Stores + eCommerce scopes and site access; pastes key + site id.
2. Or the platform's Wix app (Developers Center) is installed on the site → client_credentials token (4 h, re-mint).
3. Call the Catalog Versioning API to pick V1 vs V3 endpoints for the site.

endpoints.purpose: create products with variants (price per variant), media, categories
stock per variant per location; preorder settings
fulfilment with lineItems + trackingInfo {trackingNumber, shippingProvider, trackingLink}

reference.limits: Not numeric in the pages read; 429 means throttled — wait ~1 minute and retry. - API keys for own-account automation only; third-party distribution requires a Wix app (OAuth). - Catalog V3 rollout: apps must support V1 and V3.
mcp_sdk: MCP: Wix MCP (dev.wix.com documents API keys for 'AI agents and MCP server connections')
SDK: .md mirrors of every doc page + https://dev.wix.com/docs/llms.txt

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: Account API key from the Wix API Key Manager (account owner; Wix Stores + eCommerce scopes, site access) sent raw in the Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

fields.name: site_id
fields.help: Site id of the store (API keys are account-level, so every site-level call must carry the wix-site-id header).

me.note: GET /site-properties/v4/properties returns {properties{siteDisplayName, businessName, paymentCurrency, locale, email, ...}, version} for the site named by wix-site-id; verifies the key and the site access.

list_orders.note: POST /ecom/v1/orders/search {search: {filter: {status, createdDate: {$gte: since}}, cursorPaging: {limit (max 100)}}}; documented filterable fields include status, paymentStatus, fulfillmentStatus and createdDate ($gte...). Returns {orders[{id, number, status, paymentStatus, fulfillmentStatus, priceSummary{total{amount}}, currency, createdDate}], metadata{cursors, hasNext}}; `total` is a decimal string. Paging is cursor-based, so `page` is not sent (first page only). `since` (a date or datetime) is sent as an ISO dateTime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z, UTC): Wix rejects a bare date with 400 INVALID_QUERY_FILTER '… is not a valid dateTime filter value' (auth audit 2026-09-26).

not_offered.create_listing: POST /stores/v3/products needs product.variantsInfo.variants[{price{actualPrice{amount}}, sku}] (the price sits in an array of objects) plus physicalProperties for PHYSICAL products — not expressible in the flat/dotted body.
not_offered.update_listing: PATCH /stores/v3/products/{id} requires the current `revision` (read-then-write; 409 otherwise) and variant prices live in the variantsInfo.variants array.
not_offered.end_listing: Hiding a product is PATCH /stores/v3/products/{id} {product: {id, revision, visible: false}} — the current `revision` is required (read-then-write, 409 otherwise) and cannot be supplied by the body form; DELETE /stores/v3/products/{id} is irreversible.
not_offered.set_inventory: PATCH /stores/v3/inventory-items/{id} requires inventoryItem.revision (read-then-write) and is addressed by inventory-item id, not product id or SKU.
not_offered.mark_shipped: POST /ecom/v1/fulfillments/orders/{orderId}/create-fulfillment requires fulfillment.lineItems[{id, quantity}] (an array of the order's line-item GUIDs) beside trackingInfo{trackingNumber, shippingProvider} — not expressible in the flat/dotted body.
not_offered.listing_metrics: No per-product analytics endpoint in the Stores / eCommerce REST APIs.

evidence: host www.wixapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 2/2 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
auth_audit.notes: Fixed: list_orders sent a bare date as createdDate.$gte, which Wix rejects (400 '… is not a valid dateTime filter value'); it now sends an ISO dateTime.
